about.title: Ejaz Clinic & Advanced Surgical Hospital, Patna
paragraphs: At Ejaz Clinic, our main goal is to bring advanced medical and surgical care to all our patients. Our team of very competent and compassionate doctors dedicate their expertise in diagnosing and treating patients ailments.

We utterly understand the financial burden of healthcare and strive to make the care as affordable as feasible. We can proudly yet humbly proclaim that at Ejaz Clinic, no patient has ever been refused care due to their inability to pay for their treatment.

Dr. Ejaz Ali founded the hospital with this philosophy and built the deep foundations of this mission. Dr Shahzad, after finishing his surgical training from Mayo Clinic, took the baton in 2017. A team of expert doctors and healthcare providers was built to advance the complexity of care offered at our centre. Our team continues to grow and the variety of diseases now being treated has grown exponentially.
We look forward to taking care of patients in the most compassionate way feasible.

testimonials.title: Patients’ Stories
testimonials.subtitle: Our patients' voices echo the heart of our dedication. From heartfelt gratitude to stories of transformation, their words speak volumes about our commitment to personalized care and compassionate healing.

stories.quote: After years of severe knee pain, robotic joint replacement at Ejaz Hospital completely restored my mobility. Dr. Tariq Anwar and the nursing staff took wonderful care of me.
stories.headline: After years of severe knee pain, robotic joint replacement at Ejaz Hospital completely restored my mobility. Dr. Tariq Anwar and the nursing staff took wonderful care of me.
stories.name: Sunita Devi
stories.fullStory: I suffered from debilitating osteoarthritis in both knees for over six years, making even walking around the house agonizing. Dr. Tariq Anwar performed robotic total knee replacement at Ejaz Hospital. The surgical precision, pain-management protocol, and dedicated physiotherapy team helped me walk independently within days.

stories.quote: When my brother met with a severe accident, the emergency ICU team acted immediately. Dr. Ejaz Ali performed life-saving surgery with great expertise. Forever thankful.
stories.headline: When my brother met with a severe accident, the emergency ICU team acted immediately. Dr. Ejaz Ali performed life-saving surgery with great expertise. Forever thankful.
stories.name: Vikramaditya Singh
stories.fullStory: Following a highway collision near Gaya, my brother was brought to Ejaz Hospital past midnight in critical condition. The emergency trauma team stabilized him instantly and Dr. Ejaz Ali led a complex emergency abdominal surgery that saved his life. Their swift action and round-the-clock ICU care were truly heroic.

stories.quote: Dr. Ayesha Rehman provided exceptional care throughout my high-risk pregnancy. Her calm guidance and dedicated support ensured a safe and healthy delivery.
stories.headline: Dr. Ayesha Rehman provided exceptional care throughout my high-risk pregnancy. Her calm guidance and dedicated support ensured a safe and healthy delivery.
stories.name: Ananya Sharma
stories.fullStory: Because of complications, other clinics advised high-risk interventions. Dr. Ayesha Rehman closely monitored my condition with regular scans, personalized advice, and continuous reassurance. Thanks to her expertise and the supportive NICU & maternity nursing staff, our baby was delivered safely.

stories.quote: My laser kidney stone surgery was completely painless and I was discharged the very same day. Modern facilities, transparent advice, and very caring hospital staff.
stories.headline: My laser kidney stone surgery was completely painless and I was discharged the very same day. Modern facilities, transparent advice, and very caring hospital staff.
stories.name: Mohammad Tariq Alam
stories.fullStory: I had recurrent kidney stones that caused severe flank pain. Dr. Farhan Siddiqui performed advanced RIRS laser stone removal with zero external incisions. The procedure took less than an hour, was virtually pain-free, and I returned home the same evening. World-class treatment right here in Bihar.

stories.quote: Underwent laparoscopic gallbladder surgery under Dr. Shahzad Ejaz. The procedure was smooth with rapid recovery, and I was back to my normal routine within three days.
stories.headline: Underwent laparoscopic gallbladder surgery under Dr. Shahzad Ejaz. The procedure was smooth with rapid recovery, and I was back to my normal routine within three days.
stories.name: Rajesh Kumar
stories.fullStory: After suffering from gallstone colic for months, I consulted Dr. Shahzad Ejaz. The 3D laparoscopic procedure was performed with tiny keyhole incisions, minimal post-op pain, and I was discharged within 24 hours. The hospital hygiene and nursing attention were exemplary.

stories.quote: Our entire family has trusted Ejaz Hospital for years. The doctors are attentive, ethical, and prioritize patient health without recommending any unnecessary tests.
stories.headline: Our entire family has trusted Ejaz Hospital for years. The doctors are attentive, ethical, and prioritize patient health without recommending any unnecessary tests.
stories.name: Suresh Chokhani
stories.fullStory: Over the past several years, our family has consulted Ejaz Hospital for cardiac monitoring and general medicine. The specialists always explain treatment plans transparently, prescribe only necessary medications, and provide genuine warmth and reassurance.
